sources.title: The Constitutional Act of Denmark (Danmarks Riges Grundlov)
sources.note: § 43: no tax may be imposed, changed or abolished except by Act; § 82: municipalities have the right to manage their own affairs under State supervision.

sources.title: Denmark, individual: taxes on personal income
sources.note: A secondary source summarising the Danish Ministry of Taxation: a bottom-bracket tax of 12.01% for 2025 and 2026, a top-bracket tax of 15% above DKK 588,900 (2025), a labour market contribution of 8% and a marginal tax ceiling of 52.07% (2025); the average municipal rate is about 25%. Rates were not read at skat.dk.
